selection: Every nonoverlapping consecutive two-sentence block from all eight exposed targeted development abstracts, including empty-entity/empty-relation blocks. Never use predictions or relation labels to select text.
relationPolicy: Review every typed reference-entity pair for a directed predicate attached to those mention occurrences. Resolve anaphora only within the block. A repeated name alone does not propagate predicates between occurrences or model configurations. NOT_EXPRESSED is a local textual state, not NO_RELATION, not a real-world negative and never training data. Preserve ambiguous local readings as UNRESOLVED; exclude the entire unresolved block from pipeline scoring and disclose coverage.
NERPolicy: Project the existing source-bound flat mentions, then actually review each block. Quarantine any block containing a shared-head group or crossing an entity/group boundary. Keep these blocks in the queue denominator.
